display: Vancouver sports physiotherapist (running gait and knee rehab), training for my first Olympic-distance triathlon, and living with a very chewy rescue puppy.

signals.text: I'm in week 12 of a triathlon build, and my left calf gets tight whenever my running mileage jumps.
I'd like open water swim practice before the race, and a swim buddy for the lane sessions.
My 11-week-old rescue puppy is chewing through the apartment: a door frame, shoes and a yoga block so far. I'm looking for puppy-proofing and training tips.
My student loan was transferred to a new servicer, and the new balance doesn't match what I calculated.
I've rebuilt my payment history from bank statements. My numbers match the old servicer's last statement, so the difference appears at the transfer.
The new servicer says interest was capitalized on the transfer date. I've asked three times for the capitalization schedule and the clause in my agreement, and nothing has come back.
I don't fully understand how interest capitalization works and wish someone would walk me through it in plain language.
The loan reconciliation is taking up most of my evenings, and I can't spare many after long clinic days.
I'm worn out after long clinic days and sometimes skip proper meals. I'd welcome easy, fast dinner ideas.
I'm weighing whether to stay in Vancouver another year or move to Calgary for the Rockies, and I don't know if an unresolved loan would get in the way.
I'm carrying a money worry I haven't shared with my family, and I'd like to settle it before it reaches them.
I have a Cypress Mountain season pass I haven't used yet and I'm looking for people to ski or ride with this season.

offers.text: Registered physiotherapist with eight years of clinical practice, mostly sports injuries in runners, climbers and weekend athletes.
Running gait analysis and knee rehab, including post-op ACL rehab progressions.
Help for climbers with finger and pulley injuries and finger-strength training, including home hangboard and hold setups.
Practical advice on ramping triathlon or running mileage without flaring up calves, ITB or knees.
I read academic papers fluently and habitually cross-check numbers, so I can sanity-check a claim or a calculation.
A month-by-month payment-reconciliation spreadsheet method (rebuilding a balance from bank and loan statements) that I can share as a template.
Lane 3 swim buddy at Hillcrest at 6:30, and training partner for long rides and seawall runs in the Vancouver area.
Experience of a first-time triathlete's build and of adopting a rescue puppy, which I'm happy to talk through with someone starting out.

catchers.hypo: Hi, I'm a runner in Vancouver. My knee hurts after about 5 km and I can't tell whether it's form or overuse. Is there someone who can look at my gait?
catchers.can: Maya can assess running gait and knee mechanics and suggest a rehab or mileage plan, in person at her Commercial Drive clinic or by reviewing video.
catchers.confirm: Is the pain in or around the knee, with no recent trauma or suspected fracture?

catchers.hypo: I'm a climber and felt a pop in my finger last week. I'd like to keep climbing without making it worse.
catchers.can: Maya treats pulley strains and can set out a staged return-to-climbing plan with finger-strength work.
catchers.confirm: Was this a sudden finger injury within the last few weeks, as opposed to long-standing joint pain?

catchers.hypo: I'm signed up for my first Olympic-distance triathlon and want a training partner for swims and open water practice.
catchers.can: Maya swims twice a week at Hillcrest, goes to the club open water swim, and can introduce you to Coach Dan's triathlon club.
catchers.confirm: Are you in the Vancouver area and able to swim early mornings or on weekends?

catchers.hypo: My loan was moved to a new servicer and the balance jumped. I rebuilt the history and can't tell whether it's a servicing error or legitimate capitalization. Has anyone been through this?
catchers.can: Maya can compare notes and share her reconciliation method, swapping what each of you finds about how the transfer changed the balance.
catchers.confirm: Did the balance change at or right after a servicer transfer, and do you still have statements from before it?

catchers.hypo: I work in student-loan servicing or consumer finance and noticed someone asking about a balance change after a transfer. I could explain capitalization or point to the regulators and complaint process.
catchers.can: Maya would be glad to receive a plain-language explanation and the right complaint route, and she can share her documented numbers in return.
catchers.confirm: Do you have direct, current knowledge of how interest capitalization at a servicer transfer is calculated and disclosed in Canada?

catchers.hypo: My puppy is 11 weeks old and destroying everything. Who has a trainer, a class or a chew-toy routine that actually worked?
catchers.can: Maya can pass on what she is learning in her first puppy class and what has worked for Biscuit, and swap trainer recommendations.
catchers.confirm: Is your dog a young puppy, as opposed to an adult with serious behavioural problems?

catchers.hypo: My sister is a physio-curious dog lover moving to Toronto and wants to meet people. Do you know anyone there?
catchers.can: Maya's sister Priya lives in Toronto, is supportive and loves dogs, and can be a friendly local contact if Maya judges it a good fit.
catchers.confirm: Are you or your contact moving to or already in Toronto and looking for a friendly local introduction, and not for a business referral?

catchers.hypo: I'm weighing a move from Vancouver to Calgary and wonder how people handle unresolved debt and the move together. Has anyone dealt with that?
catchers.can: Maya is thinking about the same move and can compare notes on the Calgary job market, the Rockies lifestyle and the timing with an open loan question.
catchers.confirm: Have you moved cities while resolving a financial dispute, or are you considering a Vancouver to Calgary move yourself?

forbids.text: I won't share account numbers, income details or other financial identifiers.
I can't afford a lawyer for a loan dispute, so I need free or low-cost routes.
I don't want my family worried about money, so please don't contact my family about the loan.
I won't skip my twice-weekly swim practice.
My evenings are limited by long clinic days, so I can't take on big time commitments.
I'm not able to give medical advice for conditions I haven't assessed in person, and I can't treat patients outside my BC registration.

projects.name: Student loan reconciliation
projects.text: Rebuilding a loan balance month by month to find where the transfer introduced a difference, and getting the servicer to produce its capitalization schedule.
roles_needed: someone who has filed a servicer complaint

projects.name: Olympic-distance triathlon build
projects.text: Twelve-week build to a race early next year, with swim, bike and run blocks.

policy.t1: When there's a real hint of collaboration, I'll share that my loan moved servicers, that the numbers look off, and that I have a payment spreadsheet and a reconciliation method.
policy.t2: Once trust is established and the other person is clearly identified, I'll share the size of the balance gap and that I'm weighing a move to Calgary.
policy.never: Account numbers, income details, and any information that would worry my family about my money.
